name: Hearts & Stitches
source:
The last 100 years have been hard to everyone... That's why Hearts&Stitches has taken into their hands to create the perfect companion, a robot that will be there for you in these hard times!

But it seems your own robot isn't exactly who he says he is...
translation:
过去的100年对每个人来说都很艰难……这就是为什么Hearts&Stitches着手创造完美的伴侣，一个在困难时期为你提供帮助的机器人！

但看来你自己的机器人并不完全是他所说的那个人……
